rows.notes: Shared historical/news request helper is utils/helpers.py:4 get_data (plain GET + JSON decode + detail->auth error); it is identical for all rows here - what differs per row is only URL construction and request multiplicity. This row: base_url branches /tiingo/daily vs /iex by interval (:144-148), one request per comma-split symbol via asyncio.gather (:199-200), interval remapped to resampleFreq (1m->1min, h->1hour, :165-170), symbol column derived onto rows only for multi-symbol (:193-196), date cast differs daily-vs-intraday with tz_convert America/New_York (:228-233). No paging.

No dedicated upstream ETF model exists: provider registers EtfHistorical -> TiingoEquityHistoricalFetcher (__init__.py:19, no etf_historical.py in models/). Relative to the EquityHistorical row and the shared get_data helper (utils/helpers.py:4), nothing differs on the request surface - same daily-vs-iex branch, same per-symbol fan-out, same returned fields, same paging (none); only the model identity and query param names differ. Capability set copied from the actual fetcher code in equity_historical.py:144-200.

Single path /tiingo/news (:100). Differs from the shared get_data helper usage in equity rows: it builds a whole URL list up front - limit>1000 becomes ceil(limit/1000) precomputed offset pages (offset=page*1000, :110-113), gathered in parallel (:127) and concat-extended, with no next-page cursor. Ticker filter is server-side via symbol->tickers alias (:25). crawl_date parsed via dateutil (:65-69); tags/tickers list->comma-string validators (:59-63).

Same /tiingo/news path and same precomputed offset-page fan-out over the shared get_data helper (utils/helpers.py:4) as CompanyNews. What actually differs from the CompanyNews row: no tickers symbol filter at all (world-wide list, only optional source-domain filter, :28), data-side renames add site<-source (:46), and transform slices results[:limit or len] (:142-145). Returned fields otherwise identical contract.

Differs from equity/currency rows on the shared get_data path in three real ways: ONE request for all symbols (tickers comma query param, :126 alias), path /tiingo/crypto/prices (:125), and response is an array of ticker objects each with nested priceData rows that must be exploded (:165-181). interval->resampleFreq remap adds a day arm (7d->7day, :128-135); results sorted client-side by date (:183); no paging.

Path /tiingo/fx/{symbol}/prices (:100,124) - unlike crypto, back to per-symbol fan-out over the shared get_data helper (:153), but only ONE base URL (no daily/iex branch like equity). Rows come flat; ticker popped/re-uppercased per symbol when multi (:142-144); interval->resampleFreq with day arm (:109-116); union sorted client-side by date (:174-177); no paging.

Single symbol embedded in the path /tiingo/corporate-actions/{symbol}/distribution-yield (:52) - the shared get_data helper is called with no querystring building at all. Returned fields are one flat date+yield record set with trailingDiv1Y rename (:24); limit applied client-side as a tail slice data[-limit:] (:63), no server paging loop.
